findings.failure_path: Let target T equal base A, whose file contains two blocks with identical surrounding context. Reviewed R edits the first block; amended HEAD instead edits the second. The trees differ, but their diffs differ only in hunk locations, which patch-id ignores even with --verbatim. Both merge-bases equal A, so integration_only succeeds and silently covers unreviewed code. An inherited diff.context=0 makes this possible even without matching surrounding context.
findings.smallest_fix: Preserve changed-location information in the equivalence check, conservatively rejecting ambiguous or relocated hunks. Pin context rendering and add regression cases for duplicate blocks and diff.context=0.

findings.failure_path: In a partial clone, commits and trees can be local while a blob required by either diff is missing. Reading it triggers a promisor lazy fetch, which can execute repository-configured commands through core.sshCommand or remote.<name>.uploadpack. Disabling external diff, textconv, fsmonitor and paging does not disable this execution path; the merge-driver marker test cannot detect it.
findings.smallest_fix: Disable lazy fetching using a verified supported mechanism, leaving coverage false when objects are unavailable; conservatively reject partial-clone comparison where necessary. Add a missing-blob fixture whose configured transport writes a marker and assert it never executes.
